summary: Minimal, correct fix that rejects URLs containing forbidden whitespace characters (CR/LF/tab) before any parsing, closing the gap created by CPython's bpo-43882 splitting change. Matches the maintainers' actual accepted approach and introduces no regression or compatibility issue.

issues.description: unsafe_chars check placed before scheme validation; a short comment explaining why (CPython strips these chars during urlsplit) would help future readers but isn't required.
